description: I am a Master's student in Automation Engineering (Robotics) at the University of Vaasa, Finland. My interests include GNSS, satellite technology, robotics, AI, machine learning, and geospatial data analysis. I enjoy turning complex data into practical solutions. For this challenge, I am exploring MODIS–VIIRS satellite data harmonization to better understand global burning activity through data analytics, visualization, and anomaly detection. I am participating independently.
